name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1923: The game keeps its own list of what he does NOT have, and until now nothing in the pipeline could read a negative: every reader reads a found page and proposes an addition, so the count could only ever go up and a wrong row was invisible to all of it. One recording of the Chronicle Remaining filter falsifies rows no amount of found page reading could, and completes by subtraction - roster 135 minus remaining 19 gives the 116 he owns exactly, by name, with no model call. Wired at three points: the sweep flags a denied row, the panel shows it with its own next action, and the apply path withholds it, because a flag the register button ignores is decoration. It is time ordered, so a piece found after the page was shot is superseded rather than denied and an unestablished order stays UNKNOWN. Also joins calibration and contested to the panel - both were computed and thrown away - and fixes a CSS token that did not exist and so rendered the calming block louder than the warnings.
